images.title: 晨光 · 珍珠峡谷城
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a clear, high-quality FULL ENVIRONMENT CONCEPT for the background of a side-scrolling 2.5D game, one single continuous wide 16:9 illustration, preferably 1536x864 or 1792x1024.
World: optimistic AI-era postmodern far-future ecological civilization, refined rounded architecture and convincing layered natural geology, richly detailed polished stylized 3D game art, charming but sophisticated, matching a high quality collectible game environment rather than an architectural photograph. Shapes must be designed, inhabitable, and readable.
Camera/composition: nearly level frontal side-scrolling camera with a slight turn giving depth to buildings, never bird's-eye, never isometric, never a dramatic receding road. Upper 35–45% luminous sky; distinct far mountains, far city, middle cliff/garden and distant transit layers. Arrange visual interest toward the left and right thirds, keep the center quieter and spacious to later place the playable layer. All visible structures belong to the background at middle/far distance. Clear landscape silhouette, soft atmospheric depth, clean sharp detail in the middle distance without photographic bokeh.
Palette: dominant pearl warm-white ceramic #E8E1D1, pale warm limestone #BEB9AA, natural sage and olive greens #899A75 and #53674D, restrained champagne metal #B99B62, misty gray-violet far mountains. Natural sky can be pale blue. Architecture and earth must not be cobalt/navy/cyan. Limit blue outside the sky to tiny desaturated glass accents (well under 10%). Technology lights mainly soft ivory and warm gold with a few small mint-green indicators. Water muted jade-gray with white foam. Bright rich materials and natural light, no gray muddy global desaturation.
STRICT EXCLUSIONS: no people or characters; no foreground playable layer, no foreground house or cutaway interior, no player platforms or block grid, no close foreground walkway or railing, no furniture or desk, no game UI, no lettering, no captions, no logos, no borders, no multi-panel sheet. No giant foreground objects blocking the background. No dark dystopia, no medieval castle motifs, no needle forest, no giant spaceships, no blue neon wash. Draw ONLY the background environment as a complete composition.

Specific variation:
Hero direction: a spacious limestone valley city in warm morning sunlight. One elegant rounded ring-energy tower sits on the right third far away, ordinary lower terraced buildings on the left. A slim ivory transit viaduct runs across the lower middle distance with one small white train. Pale cliffs and two modest waterfalls surround a quiet open center; green rooftop gardens, warm ivory buildings and gray-violet mountains recede behind. Three tiny civilian flying pods spaced far apart in the sky. Strong balanced wide panorama, quiet luxurious ecological futurism.
